useCase: Detecting AI-upscaled images, resolución manipulación, and super-resolución processing
mechanism: Analiza the frequency espectro for periodic patrones introduced by interpolation algorithms and AI super-resolución models. Detecta the characteristic ringing artefactos, aliasing patrones, and hallucinated high-frequency details produced by upscaling operations.
accuracy: Medium-Alta - 80-90% for upscaled images with detectable interpolation artefactos
name: Detección de Escalado
parameters: Analysis: 2D FFT periodicity, Interpolation kernels: bilinear/bicubic/Lanczos, AI upscaler signatures: ESRGAN/Real-ESRGAN/SwinIR patrones
description: Detecta super-resolución and upscaling artefactos en imágenes. AI upscalers introduce periodic patrones and hallucinated details detectable through frequency análisis.

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Gallagher, A.C. (2005). Detection of Linear and Cubic Interpolation in JPEG Compressed Images. IEEE ICIVR.

strengths:
• Detecta both traditional and AI upscaling
• Frequency análisis reveals interpolation patrones
• Can identify specific upscaling algorithms
• Effective for detecting resolución manipulación
limitations:
• Advanced AI upscalers minimize detectable artefactos
• Original high-resolución images show no patrones
• compresión JPEG can mask interpolation artefactos
• Very slight upscaling is harder para detectar
